lines.zh: 我拎着种子袋，走过一排排月花田。
lines.en: I carry a seed pouch past rows of lunalon fields.

lines.zh: 鞋底沾满了月球土，走一步掉一块。
lines.en: My soles are caked with moon soil, shedding a clump each step.

lines.zh: 我的眼贴地，正好看清哪株苗歪了。
lines.en: My eye is near the ground, perfect for spotting a leaning sprout.

lines.zh: 紫薯藤爬过小路，我小心跨过去。
lines.en: Lunacrike vines cross the path; I step over them carefully.

lines.zh: 水桶在手里晃，浇过的土颜色更深。
lines.en: The bucket sways in my hand; watered soil turns darker.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，怕踩了刚冒头的卢娜草。
lines.en: I walk slowly, lest I crush new Luna Globe shoots.

lines.zh: 田埂是我一寸一寸垒起来的。
lines.en: I raised these field ridges inch by inch.

lines.zh: 背上的锄头磕着腰，走路有点歪。
lines.en: The hoe on my back knocks my hip; I walk a little crooked.

lines.zh: 从这片田到那片田，要数四十步。
lines.en: From this field to that one is forty steps.

lines.zh: 我把种子袋口扎紧，风大会吹跑。
lines.en: I tie the seed pouch tight; a strong wind would steal them.

lines.zh: 月光够亮，夜里也能看清垄沟。
lines.en: Moonlight is bright enough to read the furrows at night.

lines.zh: 我踩着湿泥回家，脚印排得很整齐。
lines.en: I tread wet mud home, my footprints neatly spaced.

lines.zh: 这一路没有杂草，昨天我才拔过。
lines.en: No weeds along this route; I pulled them yesterday.

lines.zh: 我数着步子撒种，一垄正好一把。
lines.en: I sow by step count, one handful to a furrow.

lines.zh: 我蹲在田边，看紫薯苗一寸寸往上顶。
lines.en: I squat by the field, watching lunacrike shoots push upward.

lines.zh: 种子袋空了，我把它翻过来抖三下。
lines.en: The seed pouch is empty; I turn it out and shake it thrice.

lines.zh: 银币埋在陶罐里，罐口盖着月花瓣。
lines.en: Silver coins sit in a clay jar capped with a lunalon petal.

lines.zh: 我把卢娜草的叶子一片片擦干净。
lines.en: I wipe the Luna Globe leaves one by one.

lines.zh: 土太干了，我用手掌捧水一点点渗。
lines.en: The soil is dry; I cup water in my palm and let it seep.

lines.zh: 我的独眼盯着地面，蚯蚓翻土我全看见。
lines.en: My single eye watches the ground; I see every earthworm turn.

lines.zh: 这一季的月花，开得比去年矮半寸。
lines.en: This season's lunalons stand half an inch shorter than last year's.

lines.zh: 我嚼一根草茎，尝出地里的咸味。
lines.en: I chew a grass stem and taste salt in the earth.

lines.zh: 锄头靠在墙边，我坐着听风过垄沟。
lines.en: The hoe leans on the wall; I sit listening to wind in the furrows.

lines.zh: 紫薯种子要晒三天，少一天都不发芽。
lines.en: Lunacrike seeds need three days of sun; one less and they will not sprout.

lines.zh: 我把最饱满的种子挑出来，留给自家田。
lines.en: I pick the plumpest seeds and keep them for my own field.

lines.zh: 月球土不肥，全靠一层层堆出来的腐叶。
lines.en: Lunalus soil is poor; it is all layered leaf mould.

lines.zh: 田边的木牌写着价，我不识几个字。
lines.en: The wooden sign shows prices; I know only a few letters.

lines.zh: 一整天没客人，我把垄沟又理了一遍。
lines.en: No customer all day, so I combed the furrows again.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底带着别的星球的土。
lines.en: The soil on your soles comes from another world.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子酸，还是蹲着舒服。
lines.en: Looking up at you strains my neck; crouching suits me better.

lines.zh: 你站在我的垄沟上，脚正好压着苗。
lines.en: You stand on my furrow, your foot right on a sprout.

lines.zh: 我闻到你手上的铁味，不是种地的人。
lines.en: I smell iron on your hands; you are no farmer.

lines.zh: 你的影子太长，把我的苗都盖住了。
lines.en: Your shadow is long and covers my seedlings.

lines.zh: 客人要买种子，还是只想看看月亮。
lines.en: Do you want seeds, or only to look at the moon?

lines.zh: 我的眼在你脚边，看见你鞋带松了。
lines.en: My eye by your feet sees your lace has come loose.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了这根藤，得赔我一枚银币。
lines.en: You crushed this vine; that costs you a silver coin.

lines.zh: 外乡人总以为月球上什么都长不出来。
lines.en: Outsiders always think nothing grows on the moon.

lines.zh: 你身上有火的味道，离我的干草远点。
lines.en: You carry the smell of fire; stay from my dry hay.

lines.zh: 我看了你半天，只在算你能买几袋。
lines.en: I have watched you a while, only reckoning how many bags you will buy.

lines.zh: 别踢土块，下面埋着刚下的种。
lines.en: Do not kick the clods; newly sown seeds lie beneath.

lines.zh: 你的手比我的干净，也比我的空。
lines.en: Your hands are cleaner than mine, and emptier.

lines.zh: 月亮照着你，也照着我这畦紫薯。
lines.en: The moon lights you, and my bed of lunacrike too.

lines.zh: 你伸手摸我的货，先放下银币。
lines.en: Hands on my goods? Coins first.

lines.zh: 你站在门口，光把货架照白了。
lines.en: You stand in the doorway; light bleaches my shelves.

lines.zh: 别踩苗，打我身上就行。
lines.en: Do not tread the shoots; hit my body instead.

lines.zh: 这一下，我今天浇的水都白费了。
lines.en: With that blow, today's watering is wasted.

lines.zh: 十五颗心也疼，我不是田里的土。
lines.en: Fifteen hearts hurt too; I am not field soil.

lines.zh: 血滴在垄沟里，明年的苗会长得怪。
lines.en: Blood in the furrow will make strange shoots next year.

lines.zh: 我护着种子袋，你打的是我的背。
lines.en: I shield the seed pouch; it is my back you strike.

lines.zh: 疼得我蹲下去，可我还攥着锄头。
lines.en: Pain drops me to a crouch, yet I keep the hoe.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的垄，也打断了我的腰。
lines.en: You broke my furrow and my back alike.

lines.zh: 扎尔人疼了会叫，我就是不认输。
lines.en: Zal cry out when hurt; still I will not yield.

lines.zh: 我退到田埂上，脚下一滑。
lines.en: I retreat onto the ridge and my foot slips.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记着，来年不收你的种。
lines.en: I will remember this: no seeds for you next year.

lines.zh: 一袋紫薯种子换一枚银币，很公道。
lines.en: A bag of lunacrike seeds for one silver coin is fair.

lines.zh: 你要是有好土，我愿意拿种子换。
lines.en: If you have good soil, I would trade seeds for it.

lines.zh: 我那罐银币，还差三枚就满了。
lines.en: My clay jar of silver coins is three short of full.

lines.zh: 别拿烂种子糊弄我，我一眼看得出。
lines.en: Do not fob me off with bad seeds; I can tell at a glance.

lines.zh: 新鲜的月花种子，今年只剩这些。
lines.en: Fresh lunalon seeds; this is all left this year.

lines.zh: 你手里的骨粉，比银币还让我心动。
lines.en: The bonemeal in your hand tempts me more than silver.

lines.zh: 卢娜种子难活，可种成了能卖大钱。
lines.en: Luna Globe seeds rarely take, but a crop pays well.

lines.zh: 我闻到熟土的味道，你刚翻过地吧。
lines.en: I smell turned earth; you have been digging.

lines.zh: 拿水来换，我这片田渴了三天。
lines.en: Bring water to trade; my field has thirsted three days.

lines.zh: 只要种子能活，价钱都好商量。
lines.en: So long as the seeds take root, the price is negotiable.

lines.zh: 你踩进苗床了，我的紫薯苗全倒了。
lines.en: You stepped into the seedbed; my lunacrike shoots all fell.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我把手里的种子撒了半袋。
lines.en: That bump spilled half a pouch of seeds from my hand.

lines.zh: 我这么矮，你走路真该低头看看。
lines.en: I am this short; you really should look down when walking.

lines.zh: 水桶翻了，刚浇的垄沟白浇了。
lines.en: The bucket tipped; the furrow I just watered is wasted.

lines.zh: 别碰我的锄头，它比我的腿还长。
lines.en: Mind my hoe; it is longer than my legs.

lines.zh: 十五颗心的身子，撞一下就退三步。
lines.en: A fifteen-heart body staggers three steps from one bump.

lines.zh: 你压坏了卢娜草，那是我留种的。
lines.en: You crushed the Luna Globe; I kept it for seed.

lines.zh: 站稳，你脚跟下还有一窝苗。
lines.en: Steady, there is a nest of seedlings under your heel.

lines.zh: 撞我可以，别撞翻那筐种子。
lines.en: Bump me if you must, but not the seed basket.

lines.zh: 我扶起木牌，价都被人撞乱了。
lines.en: I right the wooden sign; the collision scrambled my prices.

lines.zh: 我家的那位管着水渠，我管种子。
lines.en: My partner tends the channels; I tend the seeds.

lines.zh: 我们成亲那年，一起种下了第一畦月花。
lines.en: The year we married, we planted the first bed of lunalons.

lines.zh: 她嫌我身上总有泥，可她自己也是。
lines.en: She complains I am always muddy, though so is she.

lines.zh: 两个人翻地，一天能干完三天的活。
lines.en: Two digging, we finish three days' work in one.

lines.zh: 收成对半分，种子归我，银币归她。
lines.en: We split the harvest: seeds mine, silver coins hers.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子已经会认紫薯和杂草了。
lines.en: Our child can already tell lunacrike from weeds.

lines.zh: 夜里并排坐着，听作物在土里长。
lines.en: At night we sit side by side, hearing crops grow in the soil.

lines.zh: 她给我的定情物，是一把磨亮的锄头。
lines.en: Her token of love was a polished hoe.

lines.zh: 田太大，一个人守不过来，得两个人。
lines.en: The field is too large for one; it takes two.

lines.zh: 我们吵过架，最后总是一起去浇水。
lines.en: We have quarrelled, but always end up watering together.

lines.zh: 地上这粒种子还能发芽，我捡起来。
lines.en: This seed on the ground can still sprout; I pick it up.

lines.zh: 掉落的银币滚进垄沟，我趴下摸。
lines.en: A dropped silver coin rolls into the furrow; I grope for it.

lines.zh: 谁把月花瓣扔了一地，晒干还能用。
lines.en: Who scattered lunalon petals? Dried, they still serve.

lines.zh: 我捡起断掉的苗，插回湿土里。
lines.en: I pick up the broken shoot and press it back into wet soil.

lines.zh: 这截藤还活着，插土里又是一株。
lines.en: This vine cutting still lives; in soil it becomes another plant.

lines.zh: 我弯腰慢，可从不漏掉一粒种。
lines.en: I bend slowly, yet never miss a single seed.

lines.zh: 客人掉的空袋，我收回去装种子。
lines.en: Empty bags customers drop, I take back for seeds.

lines.zh: 石头压住了苗，我把它搬开。
lines.en: A stone pins a seedling; I roll it aside.

lines.zh: 捡到的锈锄头，磨一磨还能用。
lines.en: A rusted hoe I found; ground sharp, it will serve.

lines.zh: 落在地上的紫薯，我留着做种薯。
lines.en: Fallen lunacrike I keep for seed potatoes.

lines.zh: 有脚步踩乱了垄沟，我抬起头。
lines.en: Footsteps have trampled my furrow; I raise my head.

lines.zh: 那人手里拿着东西，不像种子袋。
lines.en: They carry something, but not a seed pouch.

lines.zh: 风把苗吹得乱摆，我看出不对。
lines.en: The wind flutters the shoots strangely; something is wrong.

lines.zh: 月亮被影子遮住，有人站在田头。
lines.en: The moon is shadowed; someone stands at the field's edge.

lines.zh: 他不是来买月花的，眼睛盯着水渠。
lines.en: He is not here for lunalons; his eyes are on the channel.

lines.zh: 我的独眼看见一双不属于这里的鞋。
lines.en: My single eye sees shoes that do not belong here.

lines.zh: 有人拔了我的苗，我还听得见土响。
lines.en: Someone pulled my shoots; I can still hear the soil shift.

lines.zh: 铁刃反了一下光，我往田埂后退。
lines.en: A blade flashes; I back toward the ridge.

lines.zh: 这种脚步太急，扎尔人不会这样走。
lines.en: Those steps are too hurried; Zal do not walk so.

lines.zh: 先把种子袋藏到草垛后面。
lines.en: First, hide the seed pouch behind the haystack.

lines.zh: 我退到垄沟尽头，那里有我藏的锄头。
lines.en: I retreat to the furrow's end, where my hoe is hidden.

lines.zh: 我盯着他的脚，看他会不会踩苗。
lines.en: I watch his feet, to see if he will crush the shoots.

lines.zh: 他往前一步，我就往田埂挪一步。
lines.en: Each step he advances, I shift a step along the ridge.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，让月花挡住我。
lines.en: I crouch low and let the lunalons hide me.

lines.zh: 这人不看货，只看我身后的门。
lines.en: He ignores the goods and eyes the door behind me.

lines.zh: 我数着他离水渠还有几步。
lines.en: I count the steps between him and the channel.

lines.zh: 手边的锄头柄，我攥得发热。
lines.en: The hoe handle in my hand grows warm from gripping.

lines.zh: 我绕到草垛后面，把他引离苗床。
lines.en: I slip behind the haystack to draw him from the seedbed.

lines.zh: 他拔刀的动作，比拔草还熟。
lines.en: He draws a blade more smoothly than he would pull a weed.

lines.zh: 我留了一条退路，直通村口。
lines.en: I keep one retreat open, straight to the village gate.

lines.zh: 我抡起锄头，照着你的膝盖砸下去。
lines.en: I swing the hoe down at your knees.

lines.zh: 一把种子撒你脸上，先迷你的眼。
lines.en: I fling a handful of seeds at your face to blind you.

lines.zh: 我拿水桶扣你，桶底还有半桶泥。
lines.en: I clap a bucket over you, half full of mud.

lines.zh: 别逼我，种地的人手上有的是劲。
lines.en: Do not push me; farmers carry strength in their hands.

lines.zh: 我用锄背敲你的手，让你松刀。
lines.en: I strike your hand with the hoe's back to loosen your blade.

lines.zh: 这一下是替我的紫薯苗打的。
lines.en: This blow is for my lunacrike shoots.

lines.zh: 我矮，专挑你的脚踝下手。
lines.en: Being short, I strike at your ankles.

lines.zh: 泥块砸过去，糊住你的眼睛。
lines.en: I hurl a clod to plaster your eyes.

lines.zh: 我打不赢，也要护住这畦苗。
lines.en: I may not win, but I will guard this bed of shoots.

lines.zh: 你踩坏一株，我就多打一下。
lines.en: For every shoot you crush, I strike once more.

lines.zh: 我从月球传送门出来，手里还攥着种子。
lines.en: I step from the Lunalus portal still clutching seeds.

lines.zh: 这片荒地没人要，我先翻一翻。
lines.en: This barren patch is unwanted; I will turn it first.

lines.zh: 扎尔村外多了一畦新田，就是我开的。
lines.en: A new bed outside Zal village; I opened it.

lines.zh: 我把第一把种子埋进月球土里。
lines.en: I press the first handful of seeds into moon soil.

lines.zh: 我的独眼先看见的是裂缝里的草。
lines.en: My single eye first sees grass in the crack.

lines.zh: 有人把种子袋放在我脚边就走了。
lines.en: Someone left a seed pouch at my feet and walked off.

lines.zh: 我先立木牌，再慢慢开垄。
lines.en: I plant the sign first, then open the furrows.

lines.zh: 月亮照在湿土上，我知道能种活。
lines.en: Moonlight on wet soil tells me it will grow.

lines.zh: 我把水源看了一遍，才决定在哪下锄。
lines.en: I check the water source before choosing where to dig.

lines.zh: 新土的味道，让我忘了路上的累。
lines.en: The smell of new soil makes me forget the journey.

lines.zh: 火别过来，这一田的干草一点就着。
lines.en: Keep the fire back; this field of dry hay will catch.

lines.zh: 从田埂摔下去，泥比石头还硬。
lines.en: Falling off the ridge, the mud feels harder than stone.

lines.zh: 水渠涨水了，我这短腿够不着底。
lines.en: The channel has risen; my short legs cannot reach bottom.

lines.zh: 这一炸把垄沟掀平了，我的种子呢。
lines.en: The blast flattened my furrows; where are my seeds?

lines.zh: 箭钉在木牌上，离我的眼只有一指。
lines.en: The arrow pins my sign, a finger from my eye.

lines.zh: 魔法落地的地方，苗全枯成了灰。
lines.en: Where the magic landed, every shoot withered to ash.

lines.zh: 饿了三天，我还是先给苗浇水。
lines.en: Three days hungry, yet I water the shoots first.

lines.zh: 雷劈中田边的树，我的垄沟全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the field tree; my furrows all lit up.

lines.zh: 掉下去时，我手里还捏着一粒种子。
lines.en: As I fall, a single seed is still pinched in my hand.
